name: report_safety_incident
description: Report a hospital safety incident (medication errors, patient falls, infections, device malfunctions) for analysis by a multi-agent AI system. The system provides structured classification, severity assessment, detailed analysis, and recommendations. Results are automatically stored in the hospital safety database and alerts are sent for high-severity incidents.

prompt.description: Description of the safety incident including: what happened, patient impact, location, staff involved, immediate actions taken, and any other relevant details
